(function () {
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     DESTINATIONS
     LOGIN_URL  -> forces the membership login, then sends to /portal
                   (the role router decides team vs client from there).
                   If already logged in, HubSpot skips the form and the
                   router fires immediately.
     PORTAL_URL -> /portal router (used as the "Dashboard" link when in)
     LOGOUT_URL -> confirmed working logout endpoint

  var BASE        = 'https://www.grant-graham.co.uk';
  var PORTAL_URL  = BASE + '/portal-page';            /* role router (fallback) */
  var CLIENT_URL  = BASE + '/client-portal';          /* client dashboard       */

  var LOGIN_URL   = BASE + '/_hcms/mem/login?redirect_url=' + encodeURIComponent(PORTAL_URL);

  /* Pick the logged-in member's destination + button label from gg_role.

     button always works even before a membership page has set gg_role. */
  function destFor(role) {
    if (role === 'team')   return { url: TEAM_URL,   label: 'Team hub' };
    if (role === 'client') return { url: CLIENT_URL, label: 'My portal' };
    return { url: PORTAL_URL, label: '' };  /* unknown -> router; label uses name */

  /* Don't show the bar on HubSpot membership pages (login, register, reset) */
  if (location.pathname.indexOf('/_hcms/') === 0) {
    console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] Skipped on /_hcms/ path.');

  }

  var QUOTES = [
    { t: "Senior operators only." },
    { t: "Speed is a strategy. Quality is the standard." },
    { t: "Plans are nothing; planning is everything.", a: "Eisenhower" },
    { t: "Action expresses priorities.", a: "Gandhi" },
    { t: "Clarity is kindness.", a: "Brené Brown" },
    { t: "What gets measured gets managed." },

    { t: "Operators carry the number. Advisers carry the slides." },
    { t: "Done is better than perfect.", a: "Sheryl Sandberg" },
    { t: "Boards reward what they understand." },
    { t: "Margins love clarity." },
    { t: "Compounding rewards consistency." },
    { t: "Decide. Deliver. Move on." },
    { t: "Strategize. Organize. Globalize." },
    { t: "The best leaders ask better questions." },
    { t: "If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it." },
    { t: "We do not just advise. We deliver." }
  ];

  var lastIdx = -1;
  try {
    var saved = sessionStorage.getItem('ggQuoteIdx');
    if (saved !== null) lastIdx = parseInt(saved, 10);
  } catch (e) {}
  var idx;
  do { idx = Math.floor(Math.random() * QUOTES.length); }
  while (QUOTES.length > 1 && idx === lastIdx);
  try { sessionStorage.setItem('ggQuoteIdx', String(idx)); } catch (e) {}

  var q = QUOTES[idx];
  var quoteHTML = '\u201C' + q.t + '\u201D';
  if (q.a) quoteHTML += ' <span class="gg-attrib">\u2014 ' + q.a + '</span>';

  /* Right-side cluster starts as the logged-out login button.
     A session check (below) swaps it to the logged-in state if a
     membership session is detected. */
  var actionsHTML =
    '<a class="gg-topbar-login" id="gg-topbar-login" href="' + LOGIN_URL + '" target="_self" rel="nofollow">Member login →</a>';

  var html =
    '<div class="gg-topbar" id="gg-topbar" role="region" aria-label="Grant and Graham site banner">' +
      '<div class="gg-topbar-inner">' +
        '<a class="gg-topbar-logo" href="' + BASE + '/" aria-label="Grant and Graham — home">' +
          '<img src="' + LOGO_URL + '" alt="Grant and Graham" />' +
        '</a>' +
        '<div class="gg-topbar-quote">' + quoteHTML + '</div>' +
        '<div class="gg-topbar-actions" id="gg-topbar-actions">' + actionsHTML + '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
    '</div>';

  function renderLoggedIn(name) {
    var actions = document.getElementById('gg-topbar-actions');
    if (!actions) return;
    var safe = (name || '').replace(/[<>&"]/g, '');
    var role = readCookie('gg_role');
    var dest = destFor(role);
    /* The clickable element greets by name when we have one; otherwise it
       shows the destination label ("My portal" / "Team hub"). Either way it
       links to the role-correct page (router fallback if role unknown). */
    var linkText = safe || dest.label || 'My account';
    var nameHTML = '<span class="gg-name">' + linkText + '</span>';
    /* When we DO have a name and a known role, add the small destination
       label after it so it's obvious where the click goes. */
    var hintHTML = (safe && dest.label)
      ? '<span class="gg-dash-hint">' + dest.label + '</span>'
      : '';
    actions.innerHTML =
      '<span class="gg-topbar-user">' +
        '<span class="gg-dot" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
        '<a class="gg-dash" href="' + dest.url + '">' + nameHTML + hintHTML + '</a>' +
      '</span>' +
      '<a class="gg-topbar-logout" id="gg-topbar-logout" href="' + LOGOUT_URL + '" rel="nofollow">Log out</a>';
    var lo = document.getElementById('gg-topbar-logout');
    if (lo) {
      lo.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
        // clear the flag cookies so the bar reverts immediately on return
        document.cookie = 'gg_in=;path=/;max-age=0;samesite=lax';
        document.cookie = 'gg_name=;path=/;max-age=0;samesite=lax';
        document.cookie = 'gg_role=;path=/;max-age=0;samesite=lax';
        window.location.href = LOGOUT_URL;
      });
    }
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
     LOGIN STATE DETECTION (flag cookie)
     HubSpot's session cookie is httpOnly (JS cannot read it), so each
     membership page sets a readable flag cookie gg_in=1 via HubL when the
     visitor is logged in (see companion snippet at top of this file).
     Optional gg_name carries the first name for display.
     The flag persists 24h, so the bar shows logged-in across the whole
     site after the member has loaded one portal page (always happens at
     login via the router).
     --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  function readCookie(name) {
    var m = (document.cookie || '').match(new RegExp('(?:^|;\\s*)' + name + '=([^;]*)'));
    return m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
  }

  function checkSession() {
    function evaluate(tag) {
      var flag = readCookie('gg_in');
      if (flag === '1') {
        var nm = readCookie('gg_name');
        console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] gg_in flag found (' + tag + ') -> logged-in.' + (nm ? ' name=' + nm : ' (no name yet)'));
        renderLoggedIn(nm);
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    // immediate check
    var ok = evaluate('immediate');
    // the page-level HubL snippet may set the cookie a beat after the
    // header script runs, so re-check a few times to pick up the name.
    var tries = 0;
    var iv = setInterval(function () {
      tries++;
      var flag = readCookie('gg_in');
      var nm = readCookie('gg_name');
      var rl = readCookie('gg_role');
      if (flag === '1') { renderLoggedIn(nm); }
      // stop once we have a name OR a role resolved, or after ~3s
      if ((flag === '1' && (nm || rl)) || tries > 12) {
        clearInterval(iv);
        if (!ok && flag !== '1') console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] No gg_in flag -> logged-out state.');
      }
    }, 250);
  }

  function inject() {
    if (!document.body) return false;
    if (document.getElementById('gg-topbar')) return true;
    var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
    wrapper.innerHTML = html;
    var bar = wrapper.firstChild;
    document.body.insertBefore(bar, document.body.firstChild);
    document.body.classList.add('gg-has-topbar');
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { bar.classList.add('gg-ready'); });

    var btn = document.getElementById('gg-topbar-login');
    if (btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
        ev.preventDefault(); ev.stopPropagation();
        console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] Navigating to login →', LOGIN_URL);
        window.location.href = LOGIN_URL;
      });
    }

    checkSession();

    console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] Loaded · quote ' + (idx + 1) + '/' + QUOTES.length);
    console.log('[G&G Marquee v7] Login URL:', LOGIN_URL, '· Portal:', PORTAL_URL);
    return true;
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', inject);
  } else if (!inject()) {
    var obs = new MutationObserver(function () {
      if (inject()) obs.disconnect();
    });
    obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
})();

          <div class="gg-tax-desc">Qualifying KIFC members benefit from a 3% preferential CIT rate, plus 0% withholding tax on dividends, interest, and royalties paid to non-resident shareholders, plus 0% capital gains tax. Conditional on minimum economic substance: at least 1 director (or 25%) resident, 50% of board meetings in Rwanda, asset thresholds.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="gg-tax-card">

          <div class="gg-tax-desc">Standard VAT rate 18%. Mandatory registration where annual turnover exceeds RWF 20 million. Essential goods and services (basic food, healthcare, education) are exempt or zero-rated. Filed monthly via the RRA digital platform (Mtaapay/eTax).</div>

        </div>

          <div class="gg-tax-label">Withholding Taxes (Standard)</div>
          <div class="gg-tax-desc">Standard 15% withholding on dividends, interest, royalties, and management/technical fees paid to non-residents (non-KIFC).         </div>

Collective Investment Schemes and qualifying investment funds under KIFC: tax-neutral at fund level, with PIT applying only at investor level.         </div>

          <div class="gg-tax-num">17<span class="pc"> DTAs</span></div>
          <div class="gg-tax-label">Treaty Network</div>
          <div class="gg-tax-desc">17+ Double Tax Avoidance Agreements and growing — UK, France, Belgium, Mauritius, South Africa, Korea, Czech Republic, Singapore, Turkey, Morocco, Jersey, Barbados, Qatar, UAE, China, India. Treaty rates typically reduce WHT to 5–10% on dividends, 10% on interest and royalties.</div>
        </div>

      <div class="gg-tax-note">
        <strong>The KIFC substance test — what to actually plan for:</strong> KIFC tax incentives are not a paper regime. To qualify, members must demonstrate genuine economic substance in Rwanda. Practical implications: at least 1 director (or 25% of board) must be Rwanda-resident, 50% of board meetings must be held in Rwanda, the management and control of the entity must reside in Rwanda, and asset/expenditure thresholds in Rwanda must be met. This is not a check-the-box exercise. We structure entities to meet substance from day one — including via local director appointments, board-meeting cadence, and local-staffing plans — so that when the substance test is examined, the entity passes cleanly. Rwanda is internationally compliant, white-listed, and has built KIFC specifically to avoid the harmful-tax-practices scrutiny that less rigorous jurisdictions face.

Realistically, allowing for documentation prep and KYC, plan on 1–2 weeks from instruction to having Certificate of Incorporation, TIN, and basic registrations in place. Bank account opening adds another 1–2 weeks. KIFC member applications via Rwanda Finance Limited typically take 2–6 weeks depending on activity. Sector-licensed entities (banking, insurance, telecom) take longer.</div>
        </details>
        <details class="gg-faq-acc">
          <summary>What is the Kigali International Financial Centre and who qualifies?</summary>
          <div class="gg-faq-acc-body">KIFC is Rwanda's dedicated international financial centre regime, established under the Investment Promotion and Facilitation Law 2021. It is operated by Rwanda Finance Limited (RFL). Eligible activities include holding companies, investment funds, fund management, family offices, treasury operations, regional headquarters, captive insurance, and certain financial services. Qualifying members benefit from a 3% preferential CIT rate, 0% WHT on dividends/interest/royalties paid to non-residents, and 0% capital gains tax. Conditional on demonstrating genuine economic substance in Rwanda — not a paper regime.</div>
        </details>
        <details class="gg-faq-acc">
          <summary>What does the KIFC economic substance test actually require?</summary>
          <div class="gg-faq-acc-body">To qualify for KIFC tax incentives, members must demonstrate that management and control of the entity resides in Rwanda. The headline requirements: at least 1 director must be Rwanda-resident (or 25% of the board), 50% of board meetings must be held physically in Rwanda, the entity must maintain proportionate annual expenditure in Rwanda, hire local staff aligned to the activity profile, and meet asset thresholds where applicable. We design substance from day one, including via local director services where appropriate, so the structure passes scrutiny when examined.</div>
        </details>
        <details class="gg-faq-acc">
          <summary>Are there really no foreign exchange controls?</summary>
          <div class="gg-faq-acc-body">Correct. Rwanda has no FX controls. The Rwandan Franc is freely convertible. There are no restrictions on foreign currency holdings, no restrictions on profit repatriation, and no restrictions on capital repatriation. 100% foreign ownership is permitted across all sectors, including land. Foreign capital injection is registered with the National Bank of Rwanda for transparency, but registration is straightforward and does not gate repatriation. This is a genuine rarity in sub-Saharan Africa — and a core part of why Rwanda works as a structuring jurisdiction.</div>
        </details>
        <details class="gg-faq-acc">
          <summary>Do shareholders or directors need to be Rwandan residents?</summary>
          <div class="gg-faq-acc-body">For a standard LLC, no. Foreign nationals can be both shareholders and directors of a Rwandan LLC with no nationality or residency requirement at the company level. Wholly foreign-owned subsidiaries are explicitly permitted. For KIFC member status, however, substance requirements apply: at least 1 director (or 25% of the board) must be Rwanda-resident, and 50% of board meetings must be held in Rwanda. Where local director services are needed for substance, we can provide them — experienced individuals with the right professional background, not nominee structures.</div>
        </details>

          <summary>What ongoing compliance does a Rwandan company face?</summary>

KIFC members additionally maintain a substance-evidence file (board minutes, residency proof, local-expenditure documentation) that may be examined by the regulator.
